page.overview:
Who is Ngan Pa?

Ngan Pa is an Adventurers Orient Expedition minifigure released in 2003. He is exclusive to the set 7417 Temple of Mount Everest.

Ngan Pa has dark grey legs and an earth orange torso. He wears a fur-lined jacket which has a black belt and striped top underneath, and has dark red arms with black gloves. His face is yellow, and he has a small black Fu Manchu-style mustache. He wears a large furry black hat.

Although consistently portrayed with dark grey legs in most LEGO media, an alternate printing of the 7417 Temple of Mount Everest building instructions' page 6 portrays him with grey legs instead, which are swapped with Sherpa Sangye Dorje. Both printings show him with the correct dark grey legs on page 45.

Ngan Pa is a very greedy Yeti hunter, working for Lord Sam Sinister in exchange for treasure during the search for the Temple of Mount Everest. This makes him an enemy of Johnny Thunder.
